component.name: Interstellar Terminal
component.summary: A terminal that's out of this world

description.p: Interstellar is a fast GTK 4 terminal with tabs, split panes, an animated starfield and a GUI for every option.

ul.li: 25 built-in themes, a theme studio, and import from kitty, Alacritty and base16
Splits, pane zoom, broadcast input, session restore
Command palette, quick select hints, clickable links and file:line errors
Safe paste, notifications for long commands, a drop-down (quake) mode
